title: Money for Nothing
studio_context: Hakim was brought in late and re-recorded the album's drums in two days, replacing most of Terry Williams' takes.

drum_performances.name: Omar Hakim
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Hakim plays the main groove; the album's drums are almost entirely his.

section_map.drum_approach: Big, straight rock groove with a large snare.

drum_performances.name: Terry Williams
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Plays only the improvised drum crescendo at the start.
